caption: The drawing depicts a full-body view of a male figure standing upright on a grey rectangular base. The figure has medium to dark brown skin and long, black hair. He wears a headband adorned with two feathers, one orange and one green. Around his neck is a necklace of white beads with a circular white medallion featuring a red star or cross-like symbol in the center. He is dressed in a blue or grey loincloth with a rough texture, along with a brown, furry covering over his lower garment. An orange-brown cloak drapes over his shoulders and hangs down his back. He is barefoot and lightly muscled. The figure holds a tall, slender bow in his left hand, and his right hand is relaxed at his side. The background is a plain beige color, making the figure the central focus of the composition.
title: Cigar Store Indian
